name: microsandbox

modes.label: Cloud microVM (private beta), allocated resources
modes.note: Same unit rates on all plans; the plan fee buys a monthly pool of resource-hours and usage beyond it is billed at these rates, prorated per second of runtime. Writable disk is billed extra at $0.0001/GiB-h while running (~$0.001/h for 10 GiB, not modelled here). Max sandbox size on paid plans is unpublished. The runtime is libkrun microVMs (own kernel). Re-checked 2026-09-28: 'Compute is prorated from the seconds your sandboxes actually run' (microsandbox.dev/pricing), pools in 'vcpu-hours' / 'memory gib-hours' = runtime x size; allocated vs used not stated verbatim. Cloud: 'Graceful stop plus maximum-duration and idle-timeout policies work.' (docs.microsandbox.dev/cloud/overview).

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Hard-capped pool, NO overage: 5 vCPU-h + 20 mem GiB-h + 20 disk GiB-h/month (the $ value is shown for reference only). Max 3 sandboxes (3 ephemeral / 2 persistent running), each 1 vCPU / 512 MiB / 8 GiB writable disk; 1 GiB durable storage total.

plans.name: Builder
plans.note: Pool: 500 vCPU-h ($25) + 2,000 mem GiB-h ($32.40) + 2,000 disk GiB-h ($0.20) + 50 GiB durable storage. The pools are per resource and do not substitute for each other: a 1:2 vCPU:GiB workload exhausts vCPU first, so the effective value is ~$41. Running caps: 1,000 ephemeral / 50 persistent.

plans.name: Teams
plans.note: Pool: 2,000 vCPU-h ($100) + 8,000 mem GiB-h ($129.60) + 8,000 disk GiB-h + 250 GiB durable storage (per resource, not fungible). Running caps: 25,000 ephemeral / 500 persistent.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom agreement (committed or BYOC). Published pool: 4,000 vCPU-h + 16,000 mem GiB-h + 16,000 disk GiB-h + 500 GiB durable; running caps 'set together'.

perf_source: ComputeSDK burst TTI median at 100 concurrency, 2026-09-25 (benchmarks.json). The ComputeSDK DAX run never succeeded (0/8).
caveats: The whole cloud is private beta with access by request. Its pricing is labelled 'private beta pricing', and docs snippets say the rates 'need owner confirmation before promotion'. All modes and plans are flagged beta.

Plan pools are per resource (vCPU-h, mem GiB-h, disk GiB-h, durable GiB), not dollars. included_usd is the list-price value of the vCPU + memory pools; the real value depends on workload shape (e.g. 4/8 on Builder is ~$41, not $57.40).
The Free plan is a hard cap with no overage: work stops when the pool is exhausted. Each Free sandbox is limited to 1 vCPU / 512 MiB.
The persistent-running cap is much lower than the ephemeral one (Builder 50 vs 1,000; Teams 500 vs 25,000). Plan concurrency holds the ephemeral cap.

Writable disk is billed at $0.0001/GiB-h only while the sandbox runs (usage API). Stopped persistent sandboxes pay durable storage ($0.000205/GiB-h). Snapshot storage has its own per-org hard cap (max_snapshot_storage_gib); treating snapshots as durable-storage price (~$0.15/GiB-mo) is still an assumption.

Egress billing is explicitly unanswered ('we are not making billing promises'); egress is null. The cloud offers no published ports or custom networking, so there is no inbound HTTPS preview; SSH works.
Max sandbox size on paid plans, regions, billing minimum and start fees are unpublished.
Isolation is libkrun microVMs (per the GitHub README), not Firecracker as earlier research recorded.

Billing basis confirmed as allocation: the usage API meters vCPU-seconds as runtime x configured vCPUs and memory as runtime x configured MiB (docs API reference, 2026-09-29). Idle-timeout stop is a user policy; its default is unpublished.
The local runtime (macOS Apple Silicon / Linux KVM / Windows WHP hosts) is free and open source (Apache-2.0); BYOC is by evaluation.

Browser: headless Playwright and Browser Use agents run inside the microVM (documented examples, github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox, checked 2026-09-28); no desktop/VNC/computer-use API is documented for the cloud (only a community Omarchy desktop for the local Apple Silicon runtime).
Egress re-checked 2026-09-28: pricing page lists "public egress with task-level policy" with no price; still unpublished (null).

Plan schema has per-plan max_vcpus_per_sandbox, max_memory_mib_per_sandbox, max_uptime_minutes_per_sandbox and trial_duration_days fields; values for paid plans are not published (the public plans API needs an API key). Schema text also says durable storage 'is billed at a flat per-GB-month rate (no free allotment)', which conflicts with the pricing page's '50 gib durable storage' included on Builder.

fleet.verification: Cloud access is by request; invitations in batches. No public admission criteria or ID/payment-screening checklist.
fleet.tiers: After private-beta admission: Free 3 ephemeral running / 2 persistent running and 3 total sandboxes; Builder 1,000 ephemeral / 50 persistent; Teams 25,000 ephemeral / 500 persistent; Enterprise custom.
fleet.notes: Not an immediately open self-serve service. Default 3 is conditional on admission; total retained count and persistent concurrency matter independently. 300/1,000 ephemeral fits Builder after approval; 300 persistent needs Teams and 1,000 persistent custom. No invitation/raise turnaround published.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages
